explanation_full: The grey relational analysis ranks the features based on their correlation with the target variable. The top features are VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate, with scores of 0.7931, 0.7902, and 0.7772 respectively. These features are followed by VSS, Propionate, Ethanol, COD-O, pH, ORP_Low, ORP_Mid, and Sucrose_Degradation. The KNN model performs best with an R² score of 0.81717 and an MSE of 0.012810.
